title: "Login, status, & logout"
format: html
---

## About

This document describes the testing procedures for functions related to access of Databrary 2.0 via the API using the `databraryr` package.

## Setup

```{r}
library(databraryr)
```

## Login

```{r}
#| label: "login to Databrary (production)"
login_db(email = Sys.getenv("USERNAME"),
         password = Sys.getenv("PASSWORD"),
         client_id = Sys.getenv("CLIENT_ID"),
         client_secret = Sys.getenv("CLIENT_SECRET"),
         store = FALSE,
         overwrite = FALSE)

```

## Check `whoami()`

```{r}
who <- whoami()

message(who$message, "\nGreat news, user: ", who$user)
```

## Check `get_db_stats()`

```{r}
get_db_stats()
```

## Logout

```{r}
logout_db()
```
